"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
--- scripts/report.py ---
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
--- scripts/slug.py ---
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import re
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*):(.*)$")
+_INT_RE = re.compile(r"^-?[0-9]+$")
+
+
+def _parse_setting_value(value: str):
+    """Coerce a setting value string into a bool, int, quoted text or plain string."""
+    if value == "true":
+        return True
+    if value == "false":
+        return False
+    if _INT_RE.match(value):
+        return int(value)
+    if len(value) >= 2 and value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"'):
+        return value[1:-1]
+    return value
+
+
+def handle_parse_settings(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    text = params.get("text")
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid settings"}
+
+    settings: dict = {}
+    for raw_line in text.splitlines():
+        line = raw_line.strip()
+        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
+            continue
+        match = _KEY_RE.match(line)
+        if match is None:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid settings"}
+        key, value = match.group(1), match.group(2)
+        if key in settings:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid settings"}
+        settings[key] = _parse_setting_value(value.strip())
+    return 200, {"settings": settings}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

from app.api.handlers import handle_parse_settings as h

def check(desc, got, want):
    status = "OK " if got == want else "FAIL"
    print(f"{status} {desc}: got={got!r} want={want!r}")

# basic
check("basic", h({"text": "a: 1\nb: true\nc: hello"}), (200, {"settings": {"a": 1, "b": True, "c": "hello"}}))
# comments / blanks
check("comments", h({"text": "  # c\n\n  a :\n  a: 1" if False else "  # c\n\n  a: 1\n"}), (200, {"settings": {"a": 1}}))
# key with space before colon -> invalid
check("space before colon", h({"text": "a : 1"}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
# key starts with digit
check("digit start", h({"text": "1a: 1"}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
# key invalid char
check("invalid key char", h({"text": "a-b: 1"}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
# missing colon
check("no colon", h({"text": "abc"}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
# duplicate
check("duplicate", h({"text": "a: 1\na: 2"}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
# missing / non-string
check("missing", h({}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
check("none", h({"text": None}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
check("int type", h({"text": 5}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
check("list type", h({"text": []}), (400, {"error": "invalid settings"}))
# empty string
check("empty text", h({"text": ""}), (200, {"settings": {}}))
# empty value
check("empty value", h({"text": "k:"}), (200, {"settings": {"k": ""}}))
check("empty value ws", h({"text": "k:    "}), (200, {"settings": {"k": ""}}))
# value containing colon
check("colon in value", h({"text": "url: http://x:8080/y"}), (200, {"settings": {"url": "http://x:8080/y"}}))
# bools
check("false", h({"text": "x: false"}), (200, {"settings": {"x": False}}))
check("True cap stays str", h({"text": "x: True"}), (200, {"settings": {"x": "True"}}))
